summary.text: Sue Bernard is a Republican member of the Maine Senate for Senate District 1, which covers Aroostook County communities including Caribou, Fort Kent, Madawaska and Van Buren.
The Senate page lists committee assignments to Appropriations and Financial Affairs.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Senate service in the 132nd Legislature and prior service in the House in the 130th Legislature.
